query: SELECT ?body ?bodyLabel ?type ?typeLabel ?parent ?parentLabel WHERE { VALUES ?type { wd:Q634 wd:Q2199 wd:Q3863 wd:Q3559 wd:Q2537 } { ?body wdt:P31/wdt:P279* ?type. ?body wdt:P397 wd:Q525 . BIND(wd:Q525 AS ?parent) } UNION { ?body wdt:P31/wdt:P279* ?type. ?body wdt:P397 ?planet . ?planet wdt:P397 wd:Q525 . BIND(?planet AS ?parent) } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en,de". } } LIMIT 100
